key_findings: Dual sEH/HDAC6 inhibitor 28g showed nanomolar potency and selectivity over HDAC1/3 and was more analgesic than either single inhibitor or their combination in mice.
28g reduced LPS-induced IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha and NO in RAW264.7 cells.
